title: Create Toolbar Tests
description: Create comprehensive toolbar tests for all apps (Home, Kit, Type, Design, Feedback) by smart combinations of elements. Place tests in the existing sketchpad.test.ts within corresponding app test blocks.
summary: Created comprehensive toolbar tests across all 5 apps (Home, Kit, Type, Design, Feedback) in sketchpad.test.ts. Tests verify toolbar zone structure, group toggles, settings zone activation, individual settings content, mutual exclusivity, and tool state changes. Fixed auto-activation handling with click-check-click pattern, Type ToolKind IDs (dashes not dots), and Design scroll overlay (dispatchEvent). All 6 tests pass in 3.9m.
